text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The National Bank of Slovakia rejected complaints it was carrying out a restrictive monetary policy, arguing that the nominal GDP growth over the past two years always exceeded the money supply increase.

- The Slovak Jewish Community warns against increasing extremly national, anti-Semitic and neo-Nazi sentiments in Slovakia and said this mood would accelerate during a planned visit of the far-right Frech National Front leader Jean-Marie Le Pen later this month.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Average real wages rose by nearly seven percent last year to total 8,154 crowns, while labour productivity recorded a growth of only slightly more than five percent.
- State-owned Slovak Railways (ZRS) posted a gross loss of 497 million in 1996 on revenues of around 20.7 billion crowns.
- Slovakia's largest medical equipment producer Chirana Prema posted a 1996 after-tax profit of 8.1 million crowns on turnover of 1.54 billion crowns.
- Overall tax and custom evasions now total about 23.4 billion crowns.
PRAVDA - Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin has postponed his two-day visit to Slovakia to April 28-29, from the originally scheduled dates of April 24-25.

- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar said he would only pay an official visit to Prague if Czech President Vaclav Havel appologise for his remarks that Meciar was paranoid and if the Czech Republic returns Slovak gold.

SME - It is not yet sure how long the Slovak ambassador to Prague, Ivan Mjartan, will stay in Slovakia after Bratislava recalled him for consultations earlier this week, following Havel's remarks on Meciar.
